cited.quote: District Offices of Ex-Servicemen Welfare which functions under the chairmanship of the District Collector

rationale: C1-C3 policy notes describe the existing Directorate of Ex-Servicemen's Welfare and its district offices (C3), carrying on since 1974-76. None shows a new committee for ex-army personnel and their families to address grievances. C4 is about pensioners' grievance meetings, a different group; C5 is about homeless persons with mental illness.

cited.quote: Construction of a 150 MLD capacity desalination plant was taken up at Nemmeli

rationale: The extracts cover desalination plants at Nemmeli (C2, C3) and Perur (C1), which are different plants serving Chennai. None mentions a Naripaiyur plant or its completion. C4 and C5 are irrigation and reservoir works. Only related activity is shown, so no step for this commitment.

No extract mentions an affidavit provided by fishermen associations or any step to expedite a process based on it. C1-C3 are fisheries welfare and regulation notes with no such reference; C4 (community certificates) and C5 (driving licence renewal) are unrelated.

cited.quote: the Government has extended job reservations in Tamil Nadu Government departments and quasi-government organisations

rationale: Reading retired personnel as ex-servicemen, C5 only describes existing job reservations in a policy note, with no new dedicated GO or scheme for giving priority to retired personnel. C4 raises the retirement age and C1 and C2 are about promotion committees and employment-exchange priority lists, none of which is a new measure for this commitment.

cited.quote: Government of Tamil Nadu has enacted Act No.8 of 2021, thereby offering special reservation
the certificate issuing authorities have to adopt the revised list with correct name of Scheduled Castes

rationale: C1 is a roster GO implementing Act No.8 of 2021 (in force from 26.02.2021, before this government took office) and C4 communicates a Union Act revising Scheduled Caste names. Neither shows the state initiating discussions on public requests for internal reservation or community-name changes. The extracts are on the subject but show no such step.

No extract announces a policy note or committee to review reservation policies. C1 and C4 are Adi Dravidar welfare policy notes, C2 is about rural poverty programmes, C3 is about community-certificate scrutiny committees, and C5 is a driving licence order. None is about the indicator.

cited.quote: the Government of Tamil Nadu approved a claim compensation amount of Rs.18.97 crore

rationale: The extracts are about coconut development, copra price support and crop insurance. The only compensation in C1 was for heavy-rainfall damage to onion, coriander, red chillies and banana, not coconut loss from drought or spider mite. C2-C5 show no compensation step for coconut farmers.

cited.quote: Integrating all the skill training programmes conducted by various Government departments in the State

rationale: The extracts show skill-training programmes (C3 integration through the skill corporation, C1 disability skilling plan, C2 and C4 other skill schemes) but no Right to Skill Training Act, bill or job guarantee for abandoned children, transgender people or persons with special needs. Related activity only.

cited.quote: on 02.09.2022 Tamil Nadu Widows and Destitute Women Welfare Board has been constituted
the Widows and Destitute Women Welfare Board was formed

rationale: C1 states the Tamil Nadu Widows and Destitute Women Welfare Board was constituted on 02.09.2022, after the government took office. C3 confirms the board was formed and reports a member-registration web application and 57,569 registered members.

cited.quote: Committee constituted by the Government under the chairmanship of Additional Chief Secretary
The NRCD has approved a cost of Rs.934.301 crore for

rationale: The Nadanthai Vaazhi Cauvery project, with river surface cleaning and solid waste management components, has a Government committee finalising its DPR (C1). C2 reports the central agency approved costs, but the State's share is still under consideration. It covers only the Cauvery and is not yet operational; no step is shown for Vaigai, Tamirabarani or the other rivers.

cited.quote: a new Broad Gauge Railway line between Madurai and Thoothukudi via Aruppukottai

rationale: C1 shows land-acquisition sanctions for a different new broad gauge line, Madurai to Thoothukudi via Aruppukottai. No extract mentions the Madurai-Melur-Karaikudi line. C2 and C4 list Melur roads, and C3 and C5 are about the Chennai metro. Related activity only.

cited.quote: The annual grant for repair and renovation of Mosques and Dargahs has been increased from Rs.6/- crore to Rs.10/- crore
So far Rs.241.90 lakh has been sanctioned to 41 churches under this scheme for renovation works

rationale: GOs sanction renovation money for churches (C5, dated 30.03.2023 for Rs.6 crore, then Rs.10 crore) and mosque grants rose to Rs.10 crore a year (C5); C1 lists church schemes of Rs.7 crore and Rs.10 crore allotted. The sums are far below the Rs.200 crore promised, so scope is materially reduced.

cited.quote: orders were issued in G.O.(Ms) No.176, School Education [SE5(1)] Department, dated 17.12.2021
General Transfer counselling has been conducted during January-March 2022

rationale: C1 reports a comprehensive Teachers General Transfer Counselling Policy issued by GO 176 dated 17.12.2021, and counselling held in 2022 with 18,713 teachers opting for new places. Counselling is a rule-based process, but the extract does not itself use the word transparency, so the fit is moderate.

No extract is about a Vandalur-Valajabad broad gauge rail line. C1, C2 and C4 concern Chennai Metro extensions (Vandalur appears only in a metro corridor study), C3 is about road works and C5 is a logistics policy mentioning a Walajabad goods shed.

cited.quote: orders were issued for repair/reconstruction of 14,880 Houses in 149 old Samathuvapurams in Phase-l during the year 2021-2022
issue comprehensive guidelines annexed to this order for achieving the main objective of

rationale: Directional. C4 lists GO 49 dated 30.03.2022 for repair and reconstruction of old Samathuvapurams; C5 and C3 show later phases. C1 (GO 91 of 28.06.2023) issues comprehensive guidelines for beneficiary selection to maintain social equality, the scheme's social goal. Dedicated measures exist.

cited.quote: an employee shall be allowed a day of rest every week

rationale: C5 and C1/C2 are preliminary notifications of general state rules under central labour codes giving a weekly rest day to workers in general, not an order for sanitary workers. C3 and C4 describe a sanitary workers scheme with safety gear, health insurance and training but no weekly day off.

cited.quote: this Government will continue to fight for the legitimate rights of all States
our Government urges the Union Government to refrain from levying cesses and surcharges

rationale: Directional. C1 (budget speech) and C3 (Governor's address) only state intent or urging in speeches. C2 urges the Union on language and refugee issues, not restoring state rights. None shows an Assembly resolution or a formal representation or letter to the Union Government on restoring state rights. C4 and C5 are unrelated.

None of the extracts is about a committee or legal panel on state autonomy or lost rights. C1 is the human rights commission, C2 community-certificate committees, C3 the Law Department, C4 women's committees and C5 encroachment committees.

cited.quote: Due to continuous monitoring, the progress of the project has been improved from 45.75 % to 74%
The Project is under execution and the current physical progress is 91.51%

rationale: Udangudi Stage I is under construction: progress rose from 45.75% to 74% (C1) and is 91.51% in the later note (C2), but it is not yet operational. No extract shows any step for a Cheyyur thermal project; C4 is about Cheyyur tanks. Only half the commitment shows progress, and not yet operational.

cited.quote: Kallamozhi South street Road. Km. 0/0 - 0/4

rationale: Directional. The extracts show state-wide school schemes (C4 school infrastructure repair, C2 classrooms) and an audit report (C1, C3). C5 lists a Kallamozhi road under a rural road scheme, not a school measure. No dedicated order for schools in Manappadu, Alanthalai or Kallamozhi.
